integrity: Non-word-representability of the undeleted graph is taken from the published theorem. The new contribution is certified constructively by 17 explicit total orders, each replayed as a shortcut-free semi-transitive orientation of one vertex deletion.
scientific_limitations: The result proves vertex-criticality of the published 17-vertex obstruction but does not determine whether a smaller non-word-representable induced subgraph exists elsewhere in S(3,3).
title: Petyuk's Figure-2 obstruction is vertex-critical non-word-representable
